name: qlrisk_price_total_return_swap
title: Price a TotalReturnSwap
description:
Price one Total Return Swap (qlrisk TotalReturnSwap).
Inputs (* required, name=default): maturity*, notional=1000000, spread_bp=0, initial_price, ticker=SPX, currency=USD. In `advanced` also: effective_date, issuer, coupon_pct, spot, position.
Example: {"maturity": "5Y", "notional": 1000000} gives NPV 0.00 USD (sample market valued 2026-10-09).
